properties.title: F/V Lucky Diamond, Nearshore LA
properties.content: At 1225 CST on 11May12, USCG MSU Morgan City contacted NOAA SSC about a fishing vessel that was burning (now extinguished) and adrift near the coast of central Louisiana. There is a potential release of diesel fuel and USCG is seeking a trajectory for a WCD discharge.

properties.title: Abandoned Vessel Fire and Spill, Whidbey Island, Penn Cove, WA
properties.content: NOAA SSC was called 1545 PST May 14 by WA Dept. of Health regarding a derelict vessel in Penn Cove, WA, that had a fire on board and subsequently sunk. It is 1000 ft away from Penn Cove mussel farm, and there is concern about seafood safety for the mussels. Currently there is boom around the area of diesel that has leaked from a vent from the sunken vessel; about an inch of diesel has been collected in the boom. WA Dept. of Ecology has pumped off 600 gallons, and is continuing to pump. There is a light sheen about 500 ft from the mussel rafts. WA Dept of Health has requested NOAA to provide someone with special knowledge for sensory testing of the mussels. Penn Cove has voluntarily agreed to not harvest mussels for this week.
